duplicate_consistency_review.notes: Related phenotype and sequence statements were kept separate when independently reviewable.

extraction_limitations: Single-patient clinical isolate report; no comparator cohort or patient-centered outcome analysis.
The paper reports disk-diffusion susceptibility categories but not inhibition-zone measurements or MICs.
The source contains no formal funding, conflict-of-interest, or data-sharing statement beyond the GenBank sequence accession.
No figures, tables, algorithms, appendices, or supplements were present in the two-page source.
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated molecular-genetics result context; numeric sequence-identity findings are represented as quantitative_result atoms using the isolate as an exposure-context object.
The schema has no dedicated case-report clinical-course atom kind; relevant case context is represented with population_description and limitation atoms.
